subject: STABLE step 11: in-boot A/B toggles + tile-fetch batching + runtime batch cap (gate-green)
body: Hashes: ab_schedule.inc 586e2d74; compute_frontend.m b7ebf79f; render_encoder.inc 7040617f; compositor_submit.inc 2a17808b; render_pipeline.inc 8cdba823; nord2_render_pass.inc 5283b5c4; package_metal_addon.py e3735f5e; ab_schedule_default.conf 60757eba; frame_model.py b9efe85f; ab_schedule_test.py 69e26af2; ab_schedule_main.m 322e5610; async_frontend_test.py 2fcd212e; . (1) metal/tegu/ab_schedule.inc: schedule <bundle>/ABSchedule.conf or $TEGU_AB_SCHEDULE; 'baseline S', 'phase S [NAME=v]...', 'repeat 0|1'; seconds since boot (mach_absolute_time) so all processes agree. Toggles: NORD2_METAL_PREFRAME, TEGU_NATIVE_INDEXED, TEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE, TEGU_TILE_FETCH, TEGU_JM_BATCH (0|1), NORD2_METAL_BATCH_MAX (32|128). Each command buffer snapshots its word at creation (encode + execute use it); bridge-global state (n2mb_preframe, n2mb_batch_capacity) is set per command at execute only when the schedule uses it; the pipelining FIFO keeps commit order across switches (a command queues while earlier completions are still queued). A failed command disables the toggles it had away from baseline (TEGU_AB_DISABLED ...). TEGU_PERF/TEGU_PERF_FRAME/TEGU_PERF_ENCODE start with ab=<phase>.<cycle>:PFxNIxAPxTFxJBxBMx (early in the line: the console truncates long lines) and windows are cut on a word change; window cap 600 with a schedule (90 otherwise). frame_model.py parses _ab. (2) compositor_submit.inc: render lead's tile-fetch batching hunk (LD_TILE draws share a frame; in-place memory fetch still per job) and runtime cap (draws[N2MB_BATCH_CAPACITY], n2mb_batch_capacity(conn,0)). (3) Packaging: tools/package_metal_addon.py --ab-schedule FILE ships Nord2Metal.bundle/ABSchedule.conf (manifest key ab_schedule; a stale one is removed when not asked); default schedule tools/ab_schedule_default.conf: baseline 60 s, then 45 s phases TILE_FETCH=1 / base / PREFRAME=1 / base / BATCH_MAX=128 / base / NATIVE_INDEXED=0 / base / ASYNC_PIPELINE=1 / base, cycling (450 s per cycle). ROOT, device build flags for this run: -DTEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT=0 (tile fetch compiled in, OFF by default so the toggle can turn it on; base pipelines created while it is off stay memory-fetch, specialized variants are keyed by it) and keep -DTEGU_JM_BATCH_DEFAULT (cap 128 only matters with batching). No bridge changes. Tests: new gpu/build/encode-cpu-20261026/ab_schedule_test.py (via async_frontend_test.py harness, ASan+release): baseline, NI off -> CPU expansion, command created in phase 1/executed in phase 2 keeps phase 1, JB on -> 1 job, PF on -> bridge mode 1 then back 0, AP on -> completion via FIFO, BM 128 -> bridge cap 128 then back 32, GPU failure in NI0+JB1 phase disables both; every expected TEGU_PERF ab tag present once per build, never two tags in one window. Gates: run_host_tests 55 PASS to known stop, CA ASan+release PASS, render harness rc0, async 6/6, integration 1005/2 (baseline), frame_bench unchanged, device -Werror syntax with TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT=0/1, JM_BATCH_DEFAULT, PIPELINE_DEFAULT=1. Not hardware verified; tile-fetch toggle not exercised on host beyond compile (needs a -DTEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT host build; render lead's census covered the batching hunk).
